question: In which of the following cities was India’s first bio-refinery plant inaugurated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pune**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nitin Gadkari, the Union Minister for Road Transport, Highways and Shipping**, has opened** India's First Integrated Biorefinery for Renewable Fuels and Chemicals,** which will produce ethanol from a range of biomass.
 
• Rahu is in Maharashtra's** Pune district,** and the facility is located there. Praj Industries constructed the demonstration plant.
 
• The newly opened Biorefinery plant can produce one million litres of ethanol per year by processing a range of biomass such as **rice and wheat straw, cotton stalks, bagasse, cane waste, maize cobs, and stover** with better product yields.
 
• The government asked **Oil Marketing Companies (OMCs) **in 2015 to aim for a 10% ethanol blend in as many states as feasible.
 
• The fuel doping scheme, which mandated the addition of 5% ethanol to gasoline, began in November 2012. 
 
• On January 2, 2013, it was notified under the Motor Spirits Act.
 
• The government has also permitted OMCs to purchase ethanol made from non-food feedstocks such as cellulosic and lignocellulosic materials, as well as ethanol produced through the petrochemical route.
